decisions.decision: Accept 104 -> 100, -0.21 -> +0.21, .033 -> .037. The 2018 primary author manuscript explicitly identifies its H1 cumulative SES risk (income, maternal education, marital status) versus unattended ERP amplitude finding as a conceptual replication of Stevens 2009 maternal-education-proxy work. The coded author quote and p1679/r locator identify this adapted test nonnumerically. Keep the composite-predictor adaptation explicit: this does not establish a maternal-education-only correlation. The source directly reports final analyses N100 and positive r=.21,p=.037; larger unattended amplitudes mean weaker suppression, but no coding formula recodes amplitude or SES risk, so semantic negation is not applied. The attended r=.07 and attended-minus-unattended r=-.10 are distinct outcomes. No N from df, p recalculation, alleged historical recomputation cause, author-verdict reopening, or original-field changes. Original side-level target_match and mismatch history remain frozen; field-specific review establishes current adapted target.
